content:
To clarify, our jurisdiction is limited to this server. We should not be passing judgment on members for their actions in other communities unless that drama is intentionally brought into our channels.

Regarding the ban of .kleinod: I do not currently have the full context or evidence regarding why this user was banned. We will be looking into the details of the case further before making a final decision on the ban's duration, whether to keep it, shorten it, or lift it.

In the meantime, I agree with your suggestion to update the rules. I will be adding our guidelines stating that we only enforce our rules within this Discord, except in extreme cases where external actions (like doxxing or raiding) directly threaten our members safety.

good stance, skimmed through the drama and it seems dumb to be punishing people for unrelated remarks in other communities

that said it makes sense to enforce rules if it affects this discord or is related to it (i.e. content creators posting logs from this discord to have their fanbase attack users here or directly attacking/insulting discord users in their vids is a problem imo even if it is happening outside of the discord)

Yesterday, our whale, Elite, was banned.
I believe this was undeserved. There was definitely no malicious intent or offensive subtext in his words—he was simply joking.

I've been in the RU chat for a while and can say that he is not the person you might think he is. He is kind to newcomers and open to discussions about the game. We ALREADY miss his presence in the chat, his co-op runs with D tide, and him as a person.

Please reconsider the decision regarding him, because I'm not the only one who thinks this way. Only you have the tools to heal this wound in our community...

And whoever was spamming in the chat yesterday has nothing to do with this matter; we do not support that.

I mean, he was pretty strange, not just for how he write, he did say some weird stuff, like all the rants starting from here https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1464238310481465355/1464821002088222842.
It may have been entertaining for some, but idk if it was a positive presence in the community
For my limited prospective at least
Joking or not some things shouldn't ever be said to someone online
The ban should've happened a long time ago. People keep enabling him to do whatever he wants but there are rules for a reason.
"joking" and its making sus comments about a minor
while knowing that she is a minor
